abilities.name: Grand Starfall

evidence.quote: After 0.8 seconds into the channel, Pantheon hurls his spear to the target location over 0.2 seconds that deals 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 (based on Comet Spear's rank) (+ 115% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP) physical damage to enemies near the impact and slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.
Active: Pantheon channels for 2 seconds before leaping into the sky, causing him to vanish and become immune to crowd control.
Active: Pantheon channels for 2 seconds before leaping into the sky, causing him to vanish and become immune to crowd control.
Upon completion of the channel, Pantheon will lose the crowd control immunity and reappear at the target location, as well as gain maximum stacks of Mortal Will.

notes: Grand Starfall's first channel can be interrupted by cast-inhibiting crowd control, but its second channel cannot because Pantheon gains crowd control immunity during it.

During the second channel, Pantheon gains a minimum health threshold of 1.
  - Pantheon will instantly die upon reappearing if he reaches this threshold.
Pantheon is considered to be in his original casting position even after leaping, but he will blink to the target location the moment the second channel completes.
If Pantheon leaves the Death Realm during Grand Starfall's shockwave, its hitbox will become invisible but it will still deal damage.

Experimental Hexplate Overdrive, Fiendhunter Bolts Opening Barrage, and Zeke's Convergence Frostfire Tempest activate at the end of Grand Starfall's second channel, or at the end of the initial channel if it was interrupted.
